report_name: Navigate360 Data Breach Exposes Social Security Numbers

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Actor
threat_actors.description: An unidentified threat actor responsible for the prolonged intrusion into Navigate360's network from November 2025 to March 2026, resulting in the exfiltration of sensitive personal information.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: The attacker likely performed OS credential dumping to maintain access and move laterally within the Navigate360 network during the three-month intrusion.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The attacker exfiltrated files containing sensitive data, including Social Security numbers, from Navigate360's network.

attack_patterns.name: Archive Collected Data
attack_patterns.description: The attacker likely archived collected data into formats like .zip or .rar before exfiltration, as suggested by detection guidance for suspicious archive files.

attack_patterns.name: Create Account: Local Account
attack_patterns.description: The attacker may have created new local administrator accounts for persistence within the victim network, a behavior suggested for detection in the incident analysis.

identities.name: Navigate360
identities.description: A U.S. company providing safety solutions to schools, which suffered a data breach after an attacker maintained access to its network for over three months and exfiltrated sensitive data.

identities.name: Equifax
identities.description: A credit monitoring provider mentioned as being offered to victims of the Navigate360 data breach.

identities.name: Rhode Island Residents
identities.description: A group of 189 individuals residing in Rhode Island who were affected by the Navigate360 data breach.

indicators.name: Suspicious Local Account Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Local Account Creation
id: 2b9c1d8e-4f5a-4b6c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a new local user account, which could indicate an adversary creating an account for persistence.
references:
  - https://www.claimdepot.com/data-breach/navigate360-2026
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-25
tags:
  - attack.t1136.001
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4720
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of new user accounts, which could be an indicator of an attacker establishing persistence, as suggested by the 'Cyber Observables' section.

indicators.name: Suspicious Archive File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Archive File Creation
id: 9e8f7a6b-5c4d-4e3f-2a1b-0c9d8e7f6a5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of archive files (.zip, .rar, .7z), which could be used for staging data prior to exfiltration.
references:
  - https://www.claimdepot.com/data-breach/navigate360-2026
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-25
tags:
  - attack.t1560
level: low
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.zip'
      - '.rar'
      - '.7z'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of common archive file types, which attackers often use to stage and compress data before exfiltration.

indicators.name: Anomalous Outbound Data Transfer
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Large Outbound Data Transfer
id: 7d6e5f4a-3b2c-4d1e-0a9b-8c7d6e5f4a3b
status: experimental
description: Detects potentially anomalous large outbound data transfers that could indicate data exfiltration.
references:
  - https://www.claimdepot.com/data-breach/navigate360-2026
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-25
tags:
  - attack.t1041
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    sc-bytes|gt: 10000000
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects large outbound data transfers that could be indicative of data exfiltration, such as the 'low-and-slow data egress' pattern mentioned in the report.
